geyer.translation: [人名] 盖耶; [地名] [德国] 盖尔

geyser.definition:
n. a spring that discharges hot water and steam
v. to overflow like a geyser

geysered.definition:
past tense of geyser
n. a spring that discharges hot water and steam
v. to overflow like a geyser
geysered.translation: (geyser 的过去时) n. 喷泉, 间歇泉

geyserite.definition:
n. A loose hydrated form of silica, a variety of opal,
   deposited in concretionary cauliflowerlike masses, around some hot
   springs and geysers.
geyserite.translation: n. 间歇泉周围的沉积物

geysers.definition:
n. a spring that discharges hot water and steam
v. to overflow like a geyser
geysers.translation: n. 间歇喷泉( geyser的复数形式 ); （厨房、洗澡间的）煤气热水器[炉]

geysirs.translation: (geysir 的复数)  [地名] [冰岛] 间歇泉
